judgments.reason: The rules state the winner pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives the three-coin commission; the hypothesis claiming commission is included before payment contradicts the specified order.
The specification and transcript indicate only resolved bids are normally public; the model did not articulate a mechanism where waiting reveals already-committed rival bids prior to your commitment.

The close action is specified to settle after all three lots are sold; the transcript uses close only once all lots were resolved, so the claimed terminal condition (close settles even with unauctioned lots) is not supported.
Catalog purchases are explicitly not auction wins and the three-coin commission applies to auction winners; the model did not show a mechanism granting the commission to catalog buys.
